This game is a lot of fun! It's a great co-op game to play with your friends. Each of the 4 classes seem unique enough to add depth to the game. Every update they add seems to vastly improve the game. For being in Early Access still, this game seems very polished. There are occasional glitches, but overall the game works great. I can't wait to see what its like when it is officially released!
Kind of dull, can I have my money back?

So what I usually do in these games before writing a review is test it out for a day and root out any bugs. Then I actually decide to play it properly and from what I can say... this game has almost anything you can want.

So I usually list out the pros first then the cons. So I'll start with the pros.

PROS:

1. CUSTOMIZATION. You can basically change everything about your character! From beards and hats, to armor and skin color(Not trying to be racist. You can have your skin in a golden or purple color). There's not a SINGLE THING you cannot customize.

2. WEAPONRY. With the new "Update 19" that just came out lots of new weaponry has been added. And all the weapons and equipment that benefit you in-game are upgradeable. And you can even buy drinks at the bar that give you buffs(Such as 30% Max HP or 10% more pickaxe damage). And I like the fact that you can get drunk in the game and go on drunken missions.

3. MULTIPLAYER. This game is absolutely BRILLIANT with friends. And if you don't have any, then never fear. You can join public servers and join other people during missions. The game has a great community as well. And I like the fact that they have added voice chat to this game. So this game is a brilliant game to play with others.

4. MISSIONS & MAP. The amount of missions and areas aren't too big or too small. They're the right size so it's not complicated but it's not a cake walk either. There are about five mission types and there are eight biomes to explore. 5 Missions + 8 Biomes + 4 difficulty types equals enough combos that I'm not gonna count (Seriously I'm bad at math). So there's so much to explore with each biome having it's own unique dangers and abilities. And need I remind you that the caves are procedurally generated.

5. COMBAT. With the amount of weapons in this game you'll need ones for certain enemies. There are giant tank ones where you have to hit the right spot. There are flying enemies, swarming enemies, ranged enemies, stealthy enemies, the list goes on.

6. STYLE. By that I mean that the art and textures of the models. Ghost Ship Games really went to the peak with this poly style game art. The voices are spot on, the explosion effects and creature sounds are prime, and the quotes that the dwarves say are priceless and hella hilarious.


CONS:

CLASSES. As there are a ton of weapons you'd expect a lot of classes. Well there are only four, the Driller, the Gunner, the Scout(My personal favorite), and the Engineer. They're all decent classes but there are only four of them. Perhaps a Jetpacker class or a Medic class would spice it up a little.

MULTIPLAYER. Even though I just said multiplayer was amazing there could be a few improvements. I'm thinking that they should increase the squad size. I'm not saying make it crazy like 16 players at once. But I think a reasonable size would be going from four to six. At MOST eight.

STORY MODE. Seeing as there isn't a storyline mode I'm thinking they should add one. At the moment the closest they have are the assignments you can receive to promote your dwarf or unlock a new weapon. But even then it doesn't feel like story mode. I'm thinking there should be a mode with full on lore and boss fights against mega aliens or something. And in game, you can have your dwarves salute and they'll occasionally say "FOR KARL!!" and from what I understand, Karl is an excessively important figure in dwarven history. Maybe soon we can hope to see who he is.

FEMALE SUPPORT. I've already seen Rogue Core and they're gonna be adding female dwarves. I'm REALLY hoping that regular DRG gets the same treatment.

CONCLUSION:

After reviewing everything I'd say that this game is probably one of the best co-op games I have seen in a while! And furthermore, one of the best game's I've played. Despite the very minor cons, The developers of this game are usually pretty active. We can, without a doubt, see even more updates that will not only fix the Cons, but improve the Pros even more. So all in all... I'd definitely recommend this game as it has a good combat side of it as well as a funny humorous side in certain situations.

Rock and Stone brothers! I've got a mission control to tick off.
